findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (A) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned before each use, each time there is a change in work, between uses of raw FOODS to RTE FOODS, before using FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE, and when contamination has occurred. (C) Cleaned at least every 4 hours. 

Food dispensing utensils being stored in a tub are observed soiled during this inspection. The items were shown to the PIC and moved to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure that all food contact items are completely cleaned prior to storage and maintained clean until use.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

No sanitizer is available for wiping counters/surfaces during this inspection. A bucket was made during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED. [C]

Coving is pulling away from the wall in the kitchen corner near the coolers and in the dry storage area. Seal coving to the wall.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Quaternary ammonium sanitizer measured 0 ppm at three compartment sink. Maintain concentration at 200 ppm to 400 ppm as indicated on manufacturer's label. CORRECTED- Sink was emptied and sanitizer remade to 400 ppm concentration.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.citation_text:
750.230 - Stem thermometer used for checking food temperatures was reading at 0°F while sitting at ambient temperature. Stem was then observed at 220°F prior to calibrating. After calibrating, the thermometer was still reading around 60°F at ambient temperature, while ambient temperature was at least 70°F. Manager replaced the thermometer in question with a new thermometer that was also calibrated. The new thermometer was reading more accurately.

A calibratable metal-stemmed thermometer accurate to ±2°F shall be provided for checking temperatures on food.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment:
750.160, 510, & 512 - Breakfast attendant was observed putting on gloves without first washing hands. Proper handwashing before putting on gloves/between glove changes was discussed. 

Single use gloves were also observed out of the original box on the counter prior to being worn. Proper storage and use of single use gloves were discussed. Leave gloves in the original packaging until they are needed.

Employees shall properly wash their hands any time hands may have been contaminated, before putting on gloves/between glove changes, and prior to working with food, clean equipment, and unwrapped single service articles.
Gloves shall be single use and used for only 1 task.  Gloves shall be discarded when damaged, soiled or after an interruption in operations.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text:
750.810 - Damp wiping cloths were observed hanging on the ledge of the handsink in the kitchen. Attendant stated she had a sanitizer solution that was recently emptied. Used wiping cloths were taken to soiled linen storage. Proper use of wiping cloths was discussed. Using a sanitizer solution in buckets requires storage of wiping cloths in the solution between uses. Using sanitizer in a spray bottle requires the use of disposable paper towels that are discarded after individual use.

Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.citation_text:
750.1280 - A purse and bag of clothing were observed on dry storage shelves with dry goods. Items were removed from the area. 

An adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.
